narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Multiply the exponents. Four times six gives p to the power twenty four.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Count the beads on the joined string instead.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>There are not twenty four beads on it, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 4 × 6 = 24; the beads on the joined string light up one by one; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>When the bases match, multiplying powers adds the exponents.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Find three to the power five by splitting it as three squared times three cubed.
removed_beats.on_screen: the line same base, add the exponents appears; the words 3 to the power 5 as 3² × 3³ appear with an empty box
